CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   C. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   D. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)

14. Best practice when working on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
